description: Structural assessment of a RC Bridge over Sororó river along the Carajás railway is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors J. C. L. Matos, V. H. L. Branco. The Carajás railway is operated by Vale SA and is used to transport the Brazilian production of iron ore mine located in the state of Pará until Itaqui harbor in Maranhão state. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 4310789 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
